answer: Resist sybils by locating where each identity's messages originate. Honest relays timestamp gossip receipts, and arrival-time multilateration pins each identity to a physical source. One operator's swarm shows as a dense onyx cluster: hundreds of identities at one coordinate, like a karst system draining into one sinkhole. Per-coordinate reward caps make it self-defeating — identities past the cap earn nearly nothing, so the quartz-clear math turns the marginal identity into a net loss. Arrival times can't be faked without controlling the honest relays themselves.
